organizer: Gdyński Dywizjon Okrętów Bojowych, Gdyńskie Centrum Sportu, Stowarzyszenie Oficerów Marynarki Wojennej
description: The XIII 5-Mile Race is a 5-nautical-mile (9260 m) race organized in Gdynia by the Gdynia Combat Ship Squadron and the Naval Officers’ Association in cooperation with the Gdynia Sports Centre. The course consists of two 4630 m loops and runs along the waterfront. The start and finish are in front of the ORP Gen. K. Pułaski. The race is open to active-duty professional soldiers, civilian military employees, and civilian runners following prior verification. The event takes place in a friendly atmosphere, promoting physical activity and sportsmanship.
course_highlights: Distance: 5 nautical miles (9260 m)—two 4630 m loops
Start and finish in front of the ORP Gen. K. Pułaski
Coastal course in Gdynia, not certified by the PZLA
additional: Payments are processed through Przelewy24. Participants must be verified; foreign nationals may take part after prior agreement with the organizer. The participant limit is 500. Online registration, a post-race meal, and no PZLA certification.

name: Ultra-Trail® Malopolska
location: Gorce and Beskid mountains, Małopolska, Poland
description: Ultra-Trail® Małopolska is a festival of challenging mountain races held in the Małopolska region, in the Gorce and Beskid Mountains. The event offers a range of distances from 16 to 240 km, following scenic and demanding mountain trails. It is organized by the 4 Alternatywy Foundation and attracts runners who value a challenge and the beauty of mountain nature. Ultra-Trail® Małopolska is an excellent opportunity to test your abilities on courses of varying difficulty and experience the unique atmosphere of ultra running.
course_highlights: Routes through the Gorce and Beskid Mountains
Distances from 16 km to 240 km, including highly demanding ultramarathons
Scenic and technical mountain trails
additional: The organizer is the 4 Alternatywy Foundation, based in Kraków. Other running events are also held as part of the festival, including Szczebel CUP and Winter Trail Małopolska. A Ultra-Trail® Małopolska training camp is available, led by professional instructors and camp coordinator Paweł Derlatka. The organizer and camp coordinator can be contacted at fundacja@utm.run and by phone. Registration information, route details, and event updates are available on the organizer’s website. The event also includes the winter edition, Winter Trail Małopolska, in December 2025.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Gdynia – edycja wiosenna 2026
location: Leśny Ogród Botaniczny Marszewo, Gdynia, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka Gdynia – Spring Edition 2026 is a cross-country race held in the picturesque Marszewo Forest Botanical Garden in Gdynia. The event is part of the Botaniczna Piątka race series, which has been promoting running and the beauty of natural routes in Poland since 2014. The race attracts running enthusiasts who value being close to nature and the beauty of their surroundings. It’s a great opportunity to spend time outdoors among greenery and enjoy a unique atmosphere.
course_highlights: Cross-country route through the Marszewo Forest Botanical Garden
Picturesque natural surroundings and scenic beauty
Spring race as part of the Botaniczna Piątka series
additional: The race takes place between 10:00 and 14:00. The organizers are a group of running enthusiasts who focus on cross-country races and attractive locations. The event is part of a series of races held in different Polish cities during the spring season. It is open to runners of varying abilities, with the option to take part in a 5 km race. The event promotes outdoor activity and encourages local communities to take up running.

name: I Górski Pólmaraton Szczytniański
location: Szczytna, Kłodzko County, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 1st Szczytna Mountain Half Marathon is a unique running event held in picturesque Szczytna, on a 21.1 km course with numerous mountain climbs. The race offers beautiful views of this charming town in the Kłodzko Land and a chance to connect with nature, giving every participant an unforgettable experience. The event also includes a 10 km Nordic Walking walk, an excellent option for people who enjoy active recreation without time pressure. The event’s organizer, the Szczytna Biega Association, promotes a healthy lifestyle and brings the local running community together.
course_highlights: A 21.1 km half-marathon course with numerous mountain climbs
Picturesque views and a chance to connect with nature in the charming Kłodzko Land region
Untimed 10 km Nordic Walking, with prizes and a shared finish line with the runners
additional: 10% discount for teams of 5 or more. Nordic Walking is untimed, with prizes at the finish and a shared finish line with the half-marathon participants. The Nordic Walking route passes through the most beautiful corner of the Kłodzko Land, with forest trails and a Sudeten atmosphere. Mountain running, preparation and training plans are available online; the event is aimed at fans of trail running and mountain challenges.

name: Kiełczowska Dycha i Piątka
location: Kiełczów, Wrocław, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: Kiełczowska Dycha i Piątka is a unique running event taking place on 23 May 2026 in Kiełczów. It’s a full Day of Sport, designed for professionals, amateurs and families alike. The event combines sporting competition with bringing the local community together, offering positive energy and the chance to improve your running times. It is part of the Biegowe Grand Prix Zagłębia Miedziowego and promotes physical activity at all levels.
course_highlights: A scenic, runner-friendly course in Kiełczów
Two distances to choose from: 10 km and 5 km
A family event with a welcoming atmosphere and sporting competition
additional: Registration is via the external system fitstrefa-kielczow.cms.efitness.com.pl. The event is part of the Biegowe Grand Prix Zagłębia Miedziowego. Timing is provided by Feniks - Timing, which offers professional electronic timekeeping services. Street race; online registration available; the event promotes sport and local community integration.

name: Maraton Zagłębiowski
location: ArcelorMittal Park – ZPS Sosnowiec, Sosnowiec, Śląskie, Poland
organizer: Centrum Sportu i Rekreacji w Dąbrowie Górniczej
description: The Zagłębie Marathon is a prestigious marathon held at ArcelorMittal Park - ZPS Sosnowiec. The course is officially certified by the Polish Athletics Association, guaranteeing an accurately measured distance and reliable results. The event is for runners of varying ability levels and combines sporting competition with the satisfaction of overcoming personal challenges. The organizers provide professional event management and extensive support for participants.
course_highlights: Course officially certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA)
The race takes place at ArcelorMittal Park - ZPS Sosnowiec
Professionally prepared and accurately measured course
additional: Registration is through the Datasport Registration Portal. Participants can run the marathon individually or as part of a two-person relay, with each participant completing a half marathon. The certified course allows results to be compared with those from other races. The event is part of the Zagłębie Triad, a series of three races in the region. The event includes relay options, a 6-hour time limit, and course attractions, including the halfway point at Pogoria 3 and a spectator zone.

name: Pancerna Piątka
organizer: Zarząd Wojewódzki NSZZ Policjantów województwa podkarpackiego
description: Pancerna Piątka is the Podkarpackie Police Championships in the 5 km road race, held in Żurawica. The event is held under the honorary patronage of the Podkarpackie Voivodeship Police Commander in Rzeszów. More than 400 participants take part, and the course follows roads through Żurawica. The event is organized by the Regional Board of the Independent Self-Governing Trade Union of Police Officers of the Podkarpackie Voivodeship.
course_highlights: 5 km road race
The course follows roads through Żurawica
The event is held under the honorary patronage of the Podkarpackie Voivodeship Police Commander in Rzeszów
additional: More than 400 participants take part. The event is organized by the Regional Board of the Independent Self-Governing Trade Union of Police Officers of the Podkarpackie Voivodeship. The race takes place on 23 May 2026, with electronic timing, and is part of local events promoting sport and physical activity.

name: Ultramaraton Jaga-Kora
description: The Jaga-Kora Ultramarathon is a mountain ultramarathon held in the picturesque Beskid Niski region, on routes of varying difficulty. The event commemorates the historic “Jaga-Kora” Courier Route from World War II, giving the race a unique character and historical significance. Participants can choose from five distances, ranging from 19 km to 101 km, which pass through the areas around Jaśliska and Rymanów-Zdrój. The race is certified by ITRA and UTMB, underscoring its standing in the mountain-running community.
course_highlights: The route follows the historic “Jaga-Kora” Courier Route from World War II
Five distances of varying difficulty: 101 km, 68 km, 42 km, 33 km and 19 km
The course passes through the picturesque Beskid Niski region, including Jaśliska and Rymanów-Zdrój
additional: Starts take place overnight and in the morning on 23 May 2026, with different start times for each distance. The race office is open on 22 May from 17:00 to 22:00 and on 23 May from 5:00 to 7:30. Coach transport to the starts is provided for the 100 km, 33 km and 19 km distances. The courses have specified cutoff times, and the winners’ awards ceremonies take place on the stage at the amphitheatre beside the gazebos above Czarny Potok. Prizes will not be sent to participants who are absent from the awards ceremony. Registration opens on 1 December 2025. Detailed routes and the schedule are available on the organizer’s website. The event includes aid stations and awards ceremonies, live tracking and online results.

name: Bieg Ulicą Piotrkowską Rossman Run
description: The Bieg Ulicą Piotrkowską Rossmann Run is one of Poland’s most important running events, held in central Łódź on Piotrkowska Street. Launched in 2003, the race attracts both recreational runners and leading competitors from across the country. The route runs along the city’s representative thoroughfare, and the event is accompanied by a wide range of attractions, including a food zone and a free post-race recovery meal. A Mini Run over shorter distances is organized for children and people with disabilities.
course_highlights: The route runs along Piotrkowska Street in Łódź
Start and finish near Scheiblerów Avenue, close to Poznańskich Avenue
Evening start at 19:00, with start zones assigned according to declared finish times
additional: The race office is open from Wednesday to Saturday at Łódź Fabryczna Railway Station. Bag storage and changing rooms are available at the station. Showers are available at the Well Fitness club upon presentation of a race bib. Participants can travel free of charge on Łódzka Kolej Aglomeracyjna on race day. After the race, the organizer provides a free recovery meal—a soup. Each participant can enjoy a one-hour visit to the pool and sauna area at Aquapark Fala from 20 to 25 May 2026. Accompanying persons are prohibited from travelling along the route on bicycles, scooters, or other vehicles. Traffic and public transport disruptions will occur during the race, which starts at 19:00; disruptions are expected from 18:00 to 21:30.

name: 10 Family Run
description: The 10th KSOS Family Run is a special celebration of family running held on Kraków’s Błonia. The event brings generations together, promotes physical activity and family bonding, and offers a variety of races for children and parents, as well as an open race for everyone. The event also features games and activities for children, a simultaneous chess exhibition, and artistic performances, creating a joyful, sporty atmosphere for the whole family. It’s a great opportunity to get active, meet in a relaxed setting, and enjoy moving outdoors together.
course_highlights: All races take place on the grassy area of Kraków’s Błonia
5 km Open Run with a 46-minute time limit
Children’s races from 200 m to 2,100 m, adapted to age
additional: Participants may enter more than one race. Children must provide a declaration from a parent/legal guardian. Participant limits: 90 for the Open Run, 190 combined for the Mum and Dad Runs, and 455 combined for the Children’s Races. A race pack including a T-shirt is guaranteed only with advance registration and payment. The race office is open on 22.05.2026 (16:00–20:00) and 23.05.2026 (8:30–11:30). In the “Wolf Cubs” race (children born in 2020 or later), a parent may accompany the child on the course. All races take place on the lawns of Kraków’s Błonia. The event is aimed at the local community, schools, and families. Detailed course information will be available one week before the event.

name: 23. Półmaraton Hajnowski
price_range: 180.00 PLN (standard), 90.00 PLN (zniżki dla mieszkańców powiatu Hajnowskiego i seniorów)
description: The 23rd Hajnówka Half Marathon is a unique and unforgettable race held in the picturesque area of Białowieża, near Hajnówka. The half-marathon route passes through the charming Municipal Park in Hajnówka, giving participants the chance to enjoy nature and beautiful views. The event is very popular and is organised by the Sports and Recreation Centre in Hajnówka, which takes care of runners’ comfort and safety. The race office is open the day before the race and on race day. Participants can expect race packs and a coffee buffet.
course_highlights: The route passes through the Municipal Park in Hajnówka
Picturesque landscapes of Białowieża and the surrounding area
A chance to enjoy nature and beautiful views
additional: The race office is open on 22 May from 15:00 to 21:00 at the Municipal Park Amphitheatre in Hajnówka, and on 23 May from 8:00 to 9:30. An ID card is required to collect the race pack. Running under another participant’s name is not permitted. Registration is not available on race day. Participants can enjoy a free coffee buffet. The route is on asphalt, with the start in Białowieża and the finish in Hajnówka. The race office is in the amphitheatre. Massages and showers are available after the race.

name: Bieg Lwa
location: Tarnów Podgórny, Poznań, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: Bieg Lwa is an annual half marathon held in Tarnowo Podgórne, attracting both elite runners and amateurs. The event is known for its excellent organization, attractive course, and enthusiastic crowd support. The festival also features children’s races and various accompanying events, such as cheering competitions and concerts. Bieg Lwa is a great opportunity for sporting competition and family fun in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: Half-marathon course in Tarnowo Podgórne
Pogoń za Lwem 10 km race course
Numerous refreshment stations along the course
additional: Option to transfer the race pack until 10 May 2026. Cheering Competition with a prize of PLN 1,000. Accompanying events: ØRGANEK concert, FOODSTIVAL, Hobby Horse Cup, and challenges on the stadium track. Major children’s races during the festival. Registration until 10 May, race and recovery packs, cheering competition, previous editions’ race sold out

name: Bieg Poznaniaka
organizer: Stowarzyszenie na Rzecz Edukacji Dzieci i Młodzieży z Autyzmem „Aperio”
price_range: 60-80 zł dla dorosłych, 40-45 zł dla dzieci

description: Bieg Poznaniaka dla Przedszkolaka is a family running event taking place on May 23, 2026, in the picturesque Wielkopolski National Park and on the grounds of the Museum of Agriculture in Szreniawa. The program includes main races over 11 km and 5.5 km, a Nordic Walking march, and children’s and youth races over various distances. The event is charitable, with all proceeds going to support children with autism. The organizers provide electronic timekeeping, commemorative medals, and a range of activities for participants and their families, including free museum admission and outdoor games for children.
course_highlights: The main races and Nordic Walking route follow a marked loop of approximately 5.5 km in Wielkopolski National Park
Participants in the 11 km race complete the loop twice
Children’s races take place on the grounds of the National Museum of Agriculture and Agri-Food Industry in Szreniawa
additional: Electronic timekeeping is provided for all races except the virtual race. Every participant will receive a commemorative medal. Free admission to the National Museum of Agriculture and Agri-Food Industry in Szreniawa is available, along with outdoor games for children. The start area can be reached by car, by MPK bus lines 703 and 705, or by PKP train to Szreniawa station (a 150 m walk). 11 km and 5.5 km races, Nordic Walking march, children’s races, visit to the Museum of Agriculture in Szreniawa, electronic timekeeping, commemorative medals

name: Maraton Sztafet Ekiden
location: Kampus Główny Akademii Wychowania Fizycznego, Białołęka, Warszawa, Poland
description: The 20th Onet Marathon Relay is Poland’s largest team running event. It will take place on 23 May 2026 at the Main Campus of the Józef Piłsudski University of Physical Education in Warsaw. This unique event brings together runners of all abilities, with six-person teams covering the marathon distance together in the Japanese ekiden relay format. The event promotes teamwork and cooperation, offering different relay-leg distances that make it easier for beginner runners to take part. It’s a great opportunity for friendly competition and bonding with friends, family or colleagues.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Main Campus of the Józef Piłsudski University of Physical Education in Białołęka
The course consists of two loops
A fast, team-friendly course for six-person teams
additional: Starts take place in waves; participants select their start time during registration. The race bib must be worn on the front of the outfit and kept visible. Participants should arrive well before the start to allow time to use the baggage drop, changing rooms and toilets. Time is measured net, from the moment each participant crosses the start line. Volunteers help with the event’s organization and atmosphere, and volunteer registration is open. The event promotes cooperation, community and team spirit, with different distances and categories for various age groups, including races for children and young people.

name: Nowomiejska Dycha
location: Nowe Miasto Lubawskie, Warmian-Masurian Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Urząd Miejski w Nowym Mieście Lubawskim
description: Nowomiejska Dycha is a special night street race taking place on May 23, 2026, in Nowe Miasto Lubawskie. The route winds through the town’s atmospheric historic streets, offering participants a unique experience and the chance to compete for attractive prizes. The event features two races: 5 km at 18:00 and 10 km at 20:00. Both start and finish at Nowomiejski Market Square. Participants can look forward to generous race packs, post-race meals, and a great time in charming surroundings.
course_highlights: The route runs through the atmospheric historic streets of Nowe Miasto Lubawskie
Night street races starting and finishing at Nowomiejski Market Square
Two distances: 5 km and 10 km
additional: Race packs include T-shirts, bags, commemorative magnets, and medals. Cash and merchandise prizes will be awarded to the top runners. Post-race meals will be available. Both races start and finish at Nowomiejski Market Square. The event combines a passion for running with joy and community in a charming small town. Night race, registration on Superczas.pl, prizes, race packs, festive atmosphere

name: Phoenix RUN
location: Smolarnia, Nowy Tomyśl, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Klub Biegowy Phoenix Contact Wielkopolska i Opalenicki Klub Biegacza
description: Phoenix RUN is a unique sporting event held in a scenic forest near the Smolarnia forester’s lodge, close to Nowy Tomyśl. This is the second edition of the race, organized by the Phoenix Contact Wielkopolska Running Club, bringing together running and Nordic walking enthusiasts. The event offers a range of distances for adults and children, encouraging families and friends to spend time actively together. Participants can look forward to generous race packs, commemorative medals, attractive prizes, socializing, and a chillout zone.
course_highlights: 10 km main race through the forest
5 km Nordic walking for adults
Children’s races from 100 to 800 m
additional: Start and finish at the Smolarnia forester’s lodge, close to Nowy Tomyśl. Children’s races start at 9:00; the main race and adult Nordic walking start at 11:00. The event offers opportunities to socialize, healthy food, a chillout zone, generous race packs, commemorative medals for all participants, attractive prizes for the top finishers, and a lottery. Events include a 10 km race, 5 km Nordic walking, and children’s races from 100 to 800 m. Participants can enjoy activities and prizes, and the forest route offers scenic views and an active day out.

name: Sieprawska Piątka
description: Sieprawska Piątka is an annual race held in Siepraw, attracting runners of different age groups and ability levels. The event takes place in a picturesque area, and the course runs through Słoneczny Park and the Orlik sports complex, offering participants comfortable conditions for competition and recreation. The race brings people together and promotes physical activity among residents and visitors. The organizers provide extensive sports facilities and support during the event.
course_highlights: The course runs through Słoneczny Park in Siepraw
The start and finish are located by the Orlik Sports Complex
Well-prepared sports facilities, including changing rooms and toilets
additional: The event is organized by the Gminny Ośrodek Kultury i Sportu w Sieprawiu. The Orlik Sports Complex provides sanitary facilities and changing rooms for participants. The event brings people together and promotes physical activity among the local community. It also includes a variety of sports and cultural activities involving local communities, including children’s and youth races, walks, and accompanying events.

name: Ultramaraton Jaga-Kora
description: The Jaga-Kora Ultramarathon is a mountain ultra race held in the scenic Low Beskids, near Rymanów-Zdrój. The course follows the historic Beskid Courier Route “Jaga-Kora,” which was used during World War II. The event features five races of varying difficulty and length, from 19 km to 101 km. The races are certified by ITRA and UTMB, highlighting their prestige and high organizational standards. Join us for the 10th edition, taking place on 23 May 2026.
course_highlights: The course follows the historic Beskid Courier Route “Jaga-Kora” from World War II
Five race distances: 101 km, 70 km, 42 km, 33 km and 19 km
Scenic Low Beskid landscapes, with numerous trails and historic sites
additional: Starts take place overnight and in the morning on 23 May 2026. The longest distances (100 km and 33 km) start at midnight from the market square in Jaśliska, after participants are transported by coach. The remaining distances start from Altany nad Czarnym Potokiem or Moszczaniec. The courses have designated cut-off times, and the winners’ awards ceremony takes place on the amphitheatre stage next to Altany nad Czarnym Potokiem. Prizes will not be mailed, and attendance at the awards ceremony is compulsory. Registration opens in December 2025. The event offers various distances, and participants can expect support along the course and beautiful views.

name: VII Skaryszewski Bieg Konia
location: Stadnina Koni Hubertus, Skaryszew, Masovian Voivodeship, Poland

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: opłata elektronicznie 50 zł do dnia 21.05.2026 r

description: The 7th Skaryszew Horse Run is an annual running event held at the Hubertus Horse Stud in Skaryszew. The main event is the 10 km Końska Dycha, which follows field, dirt and forest roads, offering participants a chance to enjoy nature and compete. The event promotes running as a form of active recreation and a healthy lifestyle, and brings the local community together. Children’s races are also held, making the event appealing to families.
course_highlights: The 10 km main race follows field, dirt and forest roads
Start and finish at the Hubertus Horse Stud in Skaryszew
Team classification takes competitors’ genders into account
additional: Main race limit: 150 participants. Age categories start at 16, with age-group divisions and an open classification. The team classification is based on the combined times of the four fastest runners, including at least one person of the opposite gender. Every participant receives a commemorative medal, while winners receive trophies and cash prizes in the open category. The course follows field, dirt and forest roads; registration is online and on Facebook. The outdoor event takes place whatever the weather, with prizes and medals provided.

name: X Leśne Bieganie dla Zdrowia
organizer: Gminny Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Miedźnej, Szkoła Podstawowa we Frydku, Nadleśnictwo Kobiór
description: The 10th Forest Running for Health is an annual running event organized by the Municipal Sports and Recreation Center in Miedźna, based in Wola. The races take place on forest routes of 5.5 km and 10 km, which can be downloaded in GPX format to a smartwatch or smartphone. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and outdoor activity, encouraging runners of different ages and ability levels to take part. Registration is online, and the rules are available on the organizer’s website.
course_highlights: Forest routes of 5.5 km and 10 km
Routes can be downloaded in GPX format to mobile devices
A race promoting health and outdoor physical activity
additional: The electronic entry form is available on the website. The rules and consent forms for minors are available to download. The race routes are available to download in GPX format. Registration is through an online platform. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and sport among residents of the Miedźna municipality.

name: XV Biegiem po Wichrowskich Lasach
description: XV Biegiem po Wichrowskich Lasach is an annual running event organized by the Wichrowo Forest District, attracting people who enjoy spending time actively in nature. The main event is a 10 km race through scenic forest areas. There are also races for children and young people, people with intellectual disabilities, and a Nordic walking event. The start and finish are located at the Wichrowo Forest District headquarters, and participants can take part in a familiarization run on the course.
course_highlights: The race course runs through the Wichrowo Forest District
Scenic forest trails over a distance of 10 km
Race categories for children, young people, people with disabilities, and Nordic walking
additional: The course familiarization run takes place on 6 June at 10:00. The children’s and youth races start between approximately 10:10 and 11:00. The Nordic walking event starts at 9:00 from Garnizonowa Street in Dobre Miasto and covers approximately 10 km. The start and finish of the main 10 km race are at the Wichrowo Forest District headquarters. Main race distance: 10 km; races for children and young people; Nordic walking; pre-race training; online registration until 21 May 2026; Nordic walking time limit: 2 hours.

name: XVI Bieg Koziołków
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Kędzierzynie-Koźlu
description: The 16th Bieg Koziołków is an annual running event held in Kędzierzyn-Koźle, aimed mainly at children and young people. The event takes place on 23 May 2026 and offers professional RFID timing to ensure accurate results. It is organized by the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Kędzierzyn-Koźle. The event has a family-friendly, sporting character and promotes physical activity among the youngest participants. The race is scheduled to start at 16:00, and registration is open until 18 May 2026.
course_highlights: A race for children and young people
Professional RFID timing
Held in the city of Kędzierzyn-Koźle
additional: Registration closes on 18 May 2026 at 23:59. The event is timed by Time-Sport.pl, a leader in professional timing for sporting events in Poland. Online registration is available until 18 May 2026. The event starts at 16:00 and includes various age categories, including the youngest participants, born in 2022 and later.

name: XX Bieg Lupusa
location: Bartkowo, Dobroszyce, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 20th edition of the Lupus Run will take place on May 23, 2026, in Bartkowo, Dobroszyce. This is a Polish Athletics Association (PZLA)-certified race, offering professional timing, a medal, a meal, and excellent organization and atmosphere. The event attracts athletes from across the country, creating a unique spirit of competition and camaraderie. Registration is now open on the dedicated website.
course_highlights: PZLA-certified race
Professional timing
Medal and meal for participants
additional: The Lupus Run offers professional timing, a medal, and a meal for participants. The organizers ensure a great atmosphere. The start and finish are in Bartkowo. Details about start waves, participant limits, or additional services are not available. The race starts at 10:00 in Bartkowo. The event also offers online registration and various distances, including 10 km.

name: XXI Cross Maraton przez Piekło do Nieba
description: The 21st Cross Marathon “Through Hell to Heaven” is a unique running event organized by the PTTK Branch in Końskie. The event will take place on May 23, 2026, and attracts both runners and recreational runners, offering a challenging route in scenic surroundings. The marathon is known for its interesting and demanding course, which passes through areas named Piekło and Niebo, underscoring its character and challenge. The organizers provide professional service and support for participants.
course_highlights: The route passes through the areas of Piekło and Niebo
Scenic landscapes around Końskie
Challenging cross-country terrain
additional: The organizer’s office is open Mondays from 13:00 to 17:00, and Tuesdays and Thursdays from 8:00 to 11:00. Telephone: +48 514 030 401. No details about start waves, participant limits, or entry fees are provided on the website. Participation is open to people over 18, with various age categories and classifications. The race starts at 9:00, with an earlier start for participants expecting to finish in more than 6 hours. After the race, participants will receive medals and trophies and be served refreshments.

name: XXVIII Bieg Święców
location: Sławno, Sławno County, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 28th Święcowie Run in Sławno is an annual running event taking place on May 23, 2026. The 10 km main race follows the city streets, including asphalt roads, basalt paving stones, and asphalt bike paths. The route is secured and marked, with water refreshment points along the way. The event also includes children’s and youth races at the athletics stadium over distances from 50 to 600 metres. The organizers promote community engagement and a healthy lifestyle.

The event promotes a healthy lifestyle, physical activity and the recreational attractions of the Siechnice municipality. In addition to the main races, children’s and youth races are also held. The start and finish are on Kościelna Street, at the intersection with Jana Pawła II Street, and the race starts at 9:00.
course_highlights: A road course through Siechnice on a 5 km loop
The 10 km race consists of two laps of the 5 km loop
Start and finish on Kościelna Street at the intersection with Jana Pawła II Street
additional: The race office and baggage drop are on Jana Pawła II Street, next to the Municipal Office. Race packs can be collected on Saturday and Sunday morning. The race pack includes an Oshee isotonic drink, an Eatyx bar and a race bib. Finishers receive a medal and a recovery meal. The participant limit is 700. Youth races and the Young Engineer Race for children up to age 7 are also held. Free parking is available by the LA/Błękitna Laguna stadium from 9:00 to 15:00; parking by the railway station and Toro Park shopping centre is recommended. A new system assigns race numbers using QR codes. Online registration is available, the race office is located in Siechnice, and the event also includes youth and children’s races, promoting health and recreation.

name: 3 Zduńskowolski Festiwal Biegowy
description: The 3rd Zduńska Wola Running Festival is a celebratory road race through the city of Zduńska Wola, organized to mark the 200th anniversary of the granting of city rights. The events are held over distances of 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon (21 km), with the start and finish located at the Municipal Stadium on Łaska Street. The course runs through the city and the municipality of Zapolice to the village of Brzeski in the municipality of Sędziejowice, where the half-marathon turnaround point is located. Several hundred runners take part, and the competition has a road-race, urban character.
course_highlights: Course through the streets of Zduńska Wola
Turnaround point in Brzeski, in the municipality of Sędziejowice
Start and finish at the Municipal Stadium on Łaska Street
additional: Several hundred runners take part in the event. It is organized by the Zduńska Wola City Hall. The half-marathon course is 21 km long, with a turnaround in Brzeski. The available races are 5 km, 10 km, and the half marathon. There is no information about start waves, participant limits, entry fees, or additional services. The event includes races for different age groups and ability levels, as well as attractions for families and participants of all ages.

name: 4 Bieg Zawierciański
location: Stadionie OSIR w Zawierciu, Zawiercie, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Klub Sportowy „Warto Biegać” i Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Zawierciu
description: The 4th Zawiercie Run is a running event organized by the “Warto Biegać” Sports Club and the Sports and Recreation Centre in Zawiercie. The event takes place at the OSIR Stadium in Zawiercie and features two distances: the 10 km main race and a 5 km accompanying race. The course runs through the streets of Zawiercie, is properly secured and closed to traffic, and is marked at every kilometre. The event aims to promote running and bring together runners from across the country.
course_highlights: Course through the streets of Zawiercie
Every kilometre of the course is marked
Course closed to traffic and secured
additional: The race office is open from 7:00 to 8:30 at the OSIR Stadium. Race packs can also be collected on Saturday from 16:00 to 19:00. The time limit is 1:30 for the 10 km and 1:00 for the 5 km. Electronic timing uses a returnable chip attached to the shoe. Runners must wear their race numbers pinned to the front of their shirts. Cycling, skating, skateboarding, and using other devices on the course are prohibited without the organizer’s consent. Distances: 10 km and 5 km; time limits: 1:30 for the 10 km and 1:00 for the 5 km; race packs can be collected on race day; the course is secured; participant limit: 500; online registration runs from December 6, 2025, to May 15, 2026.

name: Bieg o Koronę Księżnej Dąbrówki
organizer: Gminny Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Dopiewie
description: The Bieg o Koronę Księżnej Dąbrówki is the event’s anniversary 15th edition, traditionally held on the last Sunday of May. The main 10 km race follows forest tracks surrounded by greenery, offering pleasant conditions for running on soft surfaces. Nordic walking enthusiasts can take on a 7.5 km route, while the youngest participants can compete over shorter distances of 200 to 1,000 metres. The start and finish are located at the edge of the Palędzie–Zakrzewo forest, on Parkowa Street in Dąbrówka. The event is family-friendly and inclusive, promoting physical activity among residents of Dopiewo Municipality.
course_highlights: Main 10 km race on forest tracks surrounded by greenery
7.5 km Nordic walking route
Children’s races over distances of 200 to 1,000 metres
additional: Children’s races start at 10:15, the main race at 12:00, and the Nordic walking event at 12:02. The race office and race-pack collection are available in the days before the event at the GOSiR Dopiewo sports hall, and on race day on Parkowa Street in Dąbrówka. Individual and team classifications include categories for people with disabilities and residents of Dopiewo Municipality and LINEA Developer housing estates. Teams must be mixed (women/men). Distances: 10 km, 7.5 km, children’s races; start location: at the edge of the Palędzie–Zakrzewo forest, on Parkowa Street in Dąbrówka; date: 31 May 2026; registration is now open.

name: Festiwal Biegowy Szpot
description: The Szpot Swarzędz Running Festival is a special running event taking place on May 31, 2026. The festival features three races: the 5th Szpot Swarzędz Half Marathon, the 13th Szpot Swarzędz 10K, and the 6th Szpot Swarzędz Family Run. The half-marathon course follows two loops around picturesque Lake Swarzędzkie, while the 10K offers a dynamic profile with forest sections and streets. The event brings together sport, education, and charity. Participants can enjoy a food zone, partner expo, post-race meal, massages, and a charity auction. The festival is open to everyone, including athletes using active wheelchairs and seniors over 70, who can take part free of charge.
course_highlights: Half-marathon course: two loops around Lake Swarzędzkie
10K course: a dynamic profile with forest sections and streets in Swarzędz
The event features three races, as well as a food zone and expo
additional: Participants aged 70 and over receive a free race package for the 10K and half marathon. Limited-edition commemorative shirts for runners and families are available to purchase. Athletes using active wheelchairs will make their debut in the 10K. After the race, there will be a post-race meal, stretching and massages at the finish, and a charity auction. The event area includes the surroundings of Lake Swarzędzkie. Discounts are available for families and veterans, and new accessibility amenities are provided.

name: Krakowski Bieg Swoszowicki
description: Kraków Swoszowice Run is a family running event held in the beautiful Spa Park in Swoszowice, in the south of Kraków. It offers a variety of events: a 10 km main race, a 5 km race, a family mile, and races for children aged 1 to 11. The event brings generations together, promoting physical activity and a healthy lifestyle while fostering a sense of community among residents of Kraków and the surrounding area. In addition to sporting competition, participants can look forward to attractive race packs and a family picnic.
course_highlights: 10 km main race through District X Swoszowice and the surrounding area
Family mile over a distance of 1.6 km, with intergenerational competition
Children’s races from 50 to 300 m, tailored to different age groups
additional: The race pack includes sponsor merchandise, a race bib, and a commemorative medal awarded after finishing the race. Participants must show proof of identity and sign declarations when collecting their race pack. The race takes place on the weekend before Children’s Day, and the program also includes a family picnic. The event supports sick children, takes place in the beautiful setting of Spa Park, and attracts large numbers of participants while working with the City of Kraków.

name: LoveLasTrail
description: Love'Las Trail Przystań is a unique forest race held in the picturesque forests of Mazovia, in the heart of the Ostrołęka Forest District. This sports and recreation event combines competition with a love of nature, promoting a healthy lifestyle and social integration. Courses of varying difficulty are available to runners of different experience levels, as well as to families and Nordic walking enthusiasts. The race has an atmosphere full of positive energy and respect for nature, as confirmed by participants in previous editions.
course_highlights: Cross-country routes of varying difficulty in the heart of the forests of Mazovia
Picturesque forest trails in the Ostrołęka Forest District
Distances ranging from a family-friendly 2 km to a challenging race of around 20 km
additional: The race office is open from 7:30 to 9:30. Start times for each distance: 08:00 Maraton Leśnego Jelenia (42 km), 09:00 Król Lasu (approx. 20 km), 10:00 Bieg Wiatrów (5 km) and Trasa Wilka (10 km), 10:05 Spacer Szakala (Nordic walking, 5 km), 10:15 Zielona Przygoda (family run/walk, 2 km). The entry fee includes a race bib, returnable timing chip, commemorative souvenir, medal, post-race meal and sweet treat. Open classifications for women and men, with trophies for the top finishers, are held for the 5 km, 10 km and 20 km distances, as well as Nordic walking. Training plans and support are available to participants, and the event includes various race categories: marathon, 20 km, 10 km, 5 km and a family run. Registration is open until 25 May 2026.

name: Mazowiecka Piętnastka
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Mińsku Mazowieckim
description: Mazovian Fifteen is the 30th anniversary edition of a nationwide road race organized by the Municipal Sports and Recreation Center in Mińsk Mazowiecki. The event will take place on May 31, 2026, and is a great opportunity to celebrate through sport in this picturesque city. The road race attracts runners from across Poland, offering an appealing course and professional organization.
course_highlights: Road course in Mińsk Mazowiecki
30th anniversary edition of the race
Organizer: MOSiR Mińsk Mazowiecki
additional: road race, date: May 31, 2026, Mińsk Mazowiecki, PZLA-certified course, registration closed

name: Mokotowski Bieg SGH
description: The SGH Mokotów Run is Poland’s largest charity run organized by students, combining sport with helping those in need. The event takes place in the heart of Mokotów, Warsaw, and attracts hundreds of participants—students, alumni, residents, and running enthusiasts. The route runs along Mokotów’s streets and finishes in the SGH Rector’s Gardens. Every step makes a real difference to the lives of those in need through support for the “Akogo?” Foundation. It is not just a sporting event, but also a community built on solidarity and the energy of student engagement.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km routes along the streets of Mokotów
Finish in the SGH Rector’s Gardens
Run for children and families
additional: The event includes a meeting and partner activities area, a group warm-up before the start, and a medal ceremony after the run. It is a charity event, with funds going to the “Akogo?” Foundation, which supports people in comas. The event brings together Warsaw’s student community and residents, promoting a healthy lifestyle and helping others. Charity focus, various distances, activities and a Running Village, student community and Warsaw residents

name: Rio de Janeiro Virtual Challange
description: The Rio de Janeiro Virtual Challenge is a virtual challenge that takes you along a route through the vibrant streets and breathtaking landscapes of Rio de Janeiro, known as the Marvelous City. Participants can track their progress using a mobile app, logging various physical activities that are automatically converted into distance covered. The challenge lets you choose your own pace and completion time, and take part individually or as a team. In addition, for every bit of progress made in the challenge, the organizers plant trees or prevent plastic bottles from reaching the ocean, supporting environmental protection.
course_highlights: A 198 km (123 mi) route through Rio de Janeiro
8 virtual postcards to unlock during the challenge
Integration with popular fitness apps and smartwatches
additional: Participants have access to a private Facebook group where they can share experiences and motivate one another. The challenge lets you log any distance-based activities, including yoga or weightlifting. You can choose your own start date and challenge duration. Access to a mobile app for iOS and Android to track your progress. Participants can choose any amount of time to complete the challenge. Medals and apparel are available, and taking part supports environmental initiatives.

name: Stryszów w Biegu
description: Stryszów Municipality invites you to the sporting event “Stryszów in Motion,” taking place on 31 May 2026. The race route runs through the municipality’s scenic countryside, including fields and forests, with views of Lake Mucharskie and the surrounding hills. The event offers three distances to suit different levels of experience: 6 km for families and beginners, 10 km for runners looking for a challenge, and a 21 km mountain half marathon for experienced competitors. The event aims to promote physical activity, bring local residents together, and showcase the region’s natural attractions.
course_highlights: The route passes through fields and forests
Views of Lake Mucharskie
Hills and a mountain character for the half marathon
additional: Three distances: 6 km, 10 km and 21 km; 300-participant limit; start and finish at the LKS “Chełm” Stryszów venue; online registration until 24 May; the event promotes physical activity and the region’s natural attractions.

name: UltraPark Weekend
description: UltraPark Weekend is an ultrarunning festival held in Pabianice from May 29 to 31, 2026. The event features three main competitions: UltraPark 48h, UltraPark 24h, and UltraPark 100 km, which are also the Polish Championships in their respective categories. The races attract long-distance runners with challenging courses and a unique competitive atmosphere. The organizer is the "O Co Biega" Sports Club from Pabianice.
course_highlights: UltraPark 48h and UltraPark 24h courses
UltraPark 100 km course
The event takes place in Pabianice
additional: The event features various ultramarathon distances, with opening and closing ceremonies during the 48-hour race; registration details are not yet available

description: The 5th Po Kolei Half Marathon is a race covering approximately 21.1 km, held on 31 May 2026 in Lemany near Szczytno. The course follows a cycling path along a former railway line and local roads, offering scenic views and well-prepared hydration and refreshment stations. The event is organized by the Szczytno County Sports, Tourism and Recreation Centre and the Szczytno County Local Tourist Organization. In addition to the half marathon, children’s races and a 5 km race are also held, making the event appealing to different age groups and ability levels.
course_highlights: Course along a cycling path on a former railway line
Hydration stations at 5.5 km, 10.5 km and 16 km
Refreshment station at 10.5 km
additional: The race pack includes a race bib, commemorative T-shirt, commemorative medal and timing chip (to be returned at the finish). Minors must provide written consent from their legal guardians. The organizer provides a meal and water for all participants. The limit is 150 participants who have paid. Cash prizes are awarded to places I–III in the women’s and men’s Open classifications, as well as in additional classifications such as uniformed services and county. The race promotes physical activity; participants receive medals and T-shirts, registration is online, and the event takes place along the route of the old railway line.

name: X Charytatywny Gminny Bieg Między Wiatra...
description: The 10th Municipal Charity Run Between the Windmills is an annual running event held in Łukaszów, aimed at promoting running, sport and a healthy lifestyle. The run is a charity event, and all funds raised are donated to support people in need. The route follows a scenic loop around the windmills in Łukaszów, and participants can choose from several distances, including a children’s run, 5 km, 10 km and Nordic Walking. The organizers provide electronic timekeeping, as well as a hot meal and drinks for participants.
course_highlights: A loop around the windmills in Łukaszów
The 5 km and 10 km running routes have a time limit of 1 hour 30 minutes
A children’s run of approximately 500 m on the recreation grounds
additional: The participant limit is 200 people across all distances combined. Timekeeping is provided by Sports Timing Poland using electronic chips worn on the leg. Participants must return their chip after the run or pay 50 zł if it is lost. Participants must check in at the race office, which is open from 8:30 to 10:35. The organizer provides participants with a hot meal, cakes, water, coffee and tea. The event is a municipal charity run scheduled for 31 May 2026, supporting local initiatives.

name: XI Sieradzki Cross Towarzyski
location: Park Miejski im. A. Mickiewicza, Sieradz, Łódzkie, Poland
description: Sieradzki Cross Towarzyski is an annual running event organised by Klub Sportowy Sieradz Biega, promoting running and bringing together the running community in the city of Sieradz. The race takes place in A. Mickiewicz Municipal Park on a 2 km loop with a gravel surface and markers every 500 m. The event lasts 6 hours, during which participants compete to complete as many laps as possible, with the option to take breaks and return to the course. The event is recreational and aimed at promoting running, and participants receive electronic lap and time tracking.
course_highlights: 2 km loop in Sieradz Municipal Park
100% gravel surface
Lap markers every 500 m
additional: The race runs from 11:00 to 17:00. Participants may stop and resume running at any time, but must remain in the designated transition area during breaks. Each participant receives a reusable race bib with a chip for electronic lap and time tracking. The participant limit is 250. Minors aged 16–17 may participate with parental consent and may cover a maximum of 10 km (5 laps). Running on a 2 km loop through the park, limit of 250 participants, electronic timekeeping, commemorative medals, prizes for the top finishers, race packs.

description: TAURON Run for the Angels is a charity run held in Katowice to support the children in the care of the Angels’ Guardians Home. The event takes place in Kościuszko Park and combines sport with helping children in need. Participants can choose the 5 km main race, children’s races in various age categories, or a virtual race. All entry fees go towards educational, therapeutic, and learning support for nearly 600 children from disadvantaged backgrounds. The event also features a family picnic full of activities, and every participant receives a commemorative medal and a gift.
course_highlights: 5 km main race in Kościuszko Park, Katowice
Children’s races in various age categories
Option to take part in the virtual race from any location
additional: Children aged 0–6 can accompany a guardian free of charge on the main race course, provided they are registered in advance using the form. The event also includes an all-day Family Picnic with activities. Prizes and trophies will be awarded to the top three women and men, as well as in the children’s races. The entry fee is a donation and is non-refundable. 5 km distance, various age categories, children’s races, virtual race, family activities, registration until 15.05 and 27.05

The event offers a 10 km and a 5 km run, as well as a 5 km Nordic Walking event, with open, age-group and local-resident classifications. The start and finish are on Powstańców Wielkopolskich Street, by Primary School No. 2 in Kostrzyn. The organizer plans a prize draw for participants, and the race office is open for several hours before the start.

Start and finish on Powstańców Wielkopolskich Street, by Primary School No. 2 in Kostrzyn
Open, age-group and Kostrzyn municipality resident classifications
additional: The race office is open from 15:00 to 16:30. The organizer plans a draw for a material prize worth at least 500 zł among all race participants. Mini Kurdeszowa Za(Dyszka) features children’s races from 100 m to 800 m, depending on age category, with commemorative medals for all participants. The event also includes training sessions and prize draws, and is part of the local sporting attractions.

name: XXXIX Bieg Stolemów
location: Stadion 'Arena Mistrzów', Gniewino, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Kaszubskie Stowarzyszenie Kultury Fizycznej Żukowo oraz Gminny Ośrodek Turystyki i Sportu w Gniewinie
description: The 39th Stolemów Run is an annual 10 km race held at the “Arena Mistrzów” Sports Stadium in Gniewino. The event also includes races for children and young people, a 5 km Nordic Walking march, and a recreational run-walk. Participants can expect electronic timing, medals for all participants, and prizes for the top finishers. Those who wish to take part virtually can join the virtual race between 27 May and 4 June 2026.
course_highlights: Certified main race over 10 km
5 km Nordic Walking march
Shorter-distance races for children and young people
additional: The event begins with the race office opening at 11:00, where race bibs and timing chips are issued. A café, baggage storage, and a changing room are available. The 80 m preschoolers’ race is free, and every participant receives a medal. The 1,200 m recreational run-walk is free and requires no registration. Competitors are classified in 15 age categories. On-site registration is available for the 5 km and 10 km races. A free bouncy castle is available for the youngest participants, and coffee and cake are offered on-site by KGW Perlino. Participants can choose from various distances and age categories, and the event also includes attractions and decorations at the stadium.

name: Świętokrzyski Bieg Europejski
description: The Świętokrzyski European Run is a 5-kilometer road race held in Kielce, promoting physical activity and the spirit of European community. The course runs through the city streets, offering participants a sporting challenge in a friendly atmosphere. The event is part of the Funduszowy May 2026 events in the Świętokrzyskie Voivodeship, encouraging exercise and bringing the local community together.
course_highlights: 5-kilometer road course in Kielce
A race promoting physical activity and the European spirit
Organized as part of Funduszowy May 2026 in the Świętokrzyskie region
additional: A 5 km road race through the streets of Kielce, held as part of Funduszowy May 2026.

name: Wydminy Night Run 5K
location: Wyspa Wydmińska, Wydminy, Warmian-Masurian Voivodeship, Poland
description: Wydminy Night Run 5K is a night race held on Wydmińska Island in Wydminy. The event attracts runners who want to take on a 5-kilometer course in scenic surroundings. The race is recreational and sporting in nature, and offers a great opportunity to spend time actively and bring the local community together. The organizers promise a unique atmosphere and unforgettable experiences during the night run.
course_highlights: A 5 km course on Wydmińska Island
A night race in scenic natural surroundings
Organized as part of the local community of the Wydminy Municipality
additional: The event takes place in the evening, starting at 19:00 and ending by 23:00. Registration opens on 20 April 2026. Participants can look forward to the atmosphere of night running in the beautiful scenery of Wydminy.

4 Skolwińska Mila

The event takes place on June 13, 2026, and continues the tradition of previous editions, offering participants the chance to compete over a short distance. The race is a great opportunity to spend time actively and bring the local community together. The organizers provide an easy way to get in touch via the entry form, as well as administrative support.
course_highlights: A 1-mile (1,609-meter) course in a scenic recreational area
Online registration and timing by Sport-Time
Prizes for the top finishers and medals for everyone who finishes

name: 12. Tarczyński Nocny Wrocław Półmaraton
location: Tarczyński Arena Wrocław, Wrocław, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 12th Tarczyński Night Wrocław Half Marathon is one of Wrocław’s most important sporting events and will take place on 6 June 2026. Runners will follow a new, wide and safe course, starting and finishing at Tarczyński Arena Wrocław. The half marathon represents the city’s commitment to activity, health and openness, attracting runners from across Poland and abroad, as well as numerous spectators. The event aims to join the ranks of Europe’s largest half marathons, offering a record 21,975 entry packages—a number that refers to the race distance.
course_highlights: A new, wide and safe course
Start and finish at Tarczyński Arena Wrocław
A night race with symbolic significance for the city
additional: Start and finish by Gate A at Tarczyński Arena Wrocław. The entry package limit is 21,975, a number referring to the half marathon distance (21.0975 km). The event aims to attract more than 20,000 participants and enter the top ten largest half marathons in Europe. The start has been moved from the Olympic Stadium to Tarczyński Arena to accommodate more participants. The new course starts and finishes at Tarczyński Arena, with a focus on safety and cooperation with emergency services, as well as changes to traffic and public transport arrangements.

description: The 2nd Miasteczkowskie Forests Half Marathon is organised by the Góra Jerzego Association in Miasteczko Śląskie and will take place on 6 June 2026. The half-marathon course is approximately 21.5 km long and runs through the town’s streets, the Świerklaniec Forest District and the Tarnowskie Góry municipality. The start and finish are at the stadium next to the Sports and Recreation Centre, allowing spectators to follow the race conveniently. The event will also include a 5 km race and children’s races over various distances, promoting physical activity among the local community.
course_highlights: The course partly runs through the streets of Miasteczko Śląskie
It passes through the Świerklaniec Forest District and the Tarnowskie Góry municipality
The start and finish are at the stadium next to the Sports and Recreation Centre, with spectator stands
additional: The time limit is 4 hours for the half marathon and 1 hour for the 5 km race. Children’s races cover distances from 100 to 500 m on the CSIR sports field. The start and finish are at the Sports and Recreation Centre field, at the intersection of Dworcowa and Sportowa streets. Participants should be at the start at 10:50. The programme includes children’s races; registration is via Raatiming; the course uses the stadium and streets; the promotional period runs until 10 May 2026; parking is available nearby.

name: Poznańska Piwna Mila #19
description: The Poznań Beer Mile is an annual cross-country race held in Poznań, attracting runners who appreciate scenic routes and a sporting atmosphere. The event is part of a series of races organized by enthusiasts from the Greater Poland region, who have been promoting running and the beauty of local areas since 2014. The race features start groups with participant limits, allowing for a comfortable experience and good organization. Particular emphasis is placed on the scenic qualities of the route and bringing runners together.
course_highlights: A cross-country race on scenic routes in Poznań
Start groups capped at 60 participants
Routes with scenic appeal and a sporting character
additional: Starts take place in waves every 20 minutes from 12:00 to 15:40, including two HARD waves and a “0%” group. Each group is limited to 60 participants. The schedule of group starts with participant limits, and the event on a summer evening promotes activity and having fun.

name: Półmaraton Kurpiowski Pśejåk Bieg Szlakiem Schronów Bojowych SGO "Narew"
description: The Kurpiowski Pśejåk Half Marathon follows the route of the SGO "Narew" combat bunkers in Nowogród. The half-marathon course passes through historic areas dotted with numerous combat bunkers, giving the race a unique character and combining sport with history. The event attracts runners who value both off-road challenges and the atmosphere of the Kurpiowszczyzna region. It is an excellent opportunity to spend time actively and learn about local history.

description: Ultramaraton Babia Góra is a prestigious mountain race taking place on 6 June 2026 in Lipnica Wielka. The event offers various distances, including ultramarathons involving multiple laps of Babia Góra and shorter races such as SkyRace®. The course runs through the scenic areas of Babia Góra National Park, with challenging climbs and spectacular views. The event promotes an active lifestyle and supports the charitable work of the Rak’n’Roll Foundation. The organiser provides aid stations, medical support, and the option to have drop bags delivered to the course for the longest distances.
course_highlights: The course runs through Babia Góra National Park and includes multiple ascents of Babia Góra
Checkpoint cut-off times on key sections of the course
Scenic views and challenging climbs on mountain trails
additional: Start and finish at Polana Stańcowa in Lipnica Wielka. Race office open on 5 June from 18:00 to 20:00. Participant limits apply to individual races; registration is suspended once a limit is reached. Aid stations are available on the course, and drop bags can be delivered for the 6xBabia Góra Ultramarathon. Mandatory cut-off times apply at checkpoints; missing a cut-off results in disqualification from the remainder of the race. Medical and GOPR mountain rescue support is provided. Runners must report their withdrawal by SMS if they stop racing. Registration is limited for some distances; the course includes Polana Stańcowa and Lipnica Wielka, with a checkpoint at the PTTK Markowe Szczawiny Mountain Hostel. Accommodation is available in Lipnica Wielka.

name: Cross Maraton u Ryśka vol 84
description: Cross Maraton u Ryśka vol 84 is a race held in Wieluń and part of Liga Biegowa, a platform promoting physical activity and running competitions in Poland. The event is open to runners at various distances: 5 km, 10 km, half marathon and marathon. Liga Biegowa allows participants to earn points and compete in numerous rankings throughout the year, encouraging regular running and athletic development. The race is open and inclusive, welcoming both recreational and more experienced runners.
course_highlights: Marathon distance (42 km)
Scenic route in Wieluń
Annual traditional running event
additional: Liga Biegowa is a year-round running platform that automatically records results for races at 5 km, 10 km, half-marathon and marathon distances, converts them into points and enables competition in numerous rankings. Participants can create private leagues and access materials on training, diet and sports psychology. No details are available about the route, registration or other notes concerning this specific race.

name: Kwietny Bieg
description: The Kwietny Bieg in Lisowice is a unique 24-hour running relay that commemorates the spirit of freedom awakened by Pope John Paul II during his first pilgrimage to Poland. The race takes place on a certified 1,352-metre loop that is clearly marked and illuminated after dark. The event is open to everyone and is growing in popularity, attracting a record number of participants. Everyone who completes 10 Flower Miles (35.3 km) receives a certificate and commemorative medal. It is not only a sporting competition, but also a community event with an atmosphere full of positive energy.
course_highlights: A 1,352-metre loop certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA)
A clearly marked course illuminated after dark with torches and lights
A relay running along Poland’s borders, with the Flower Mile (3,530 m) as its symbolic unit
additional: The race takes place on a 24-hour loop, with participants running in a relay while carrying a red-and-white sash. After completing 10 Flower Miles (35.3 km), participants receive a certificate and medal. The course is illuminated after dark, and the race is open to everyone and free of charge. 24-hour relay race, 1,352 m course certified by the PZLA, free entry, record number of participants

name: Nocna Dycha Kopernika Bieg z Panem Kleksem
description: Nocna Dycha Kopernika is a unique street race held in the magical setting of Toruń, the city of Copernicus. Participants can choose from the 10 km and 5 km distances, Nordic Walking, and a special children’s race, “Odkrywcy Mocy” (“Discoverers of Power”). The event takes place at night, giving it a distinctive atmosphere and appeal. The start and finish are located in the city, and the organizers provide full logistical support and attractive race packs.
course_highlights: A night race through the streets of Toruń, the city of Copernicus
10 km start at Galeria Copernicus; finish at the Municipal Stadium
Available events: 10 km, 5 km, Nordic Walking, and children’s races
additional: The race office is open on June 6, 2026, from 15:00 to 21:00 at Galeria Copernicus, next to the Decathlon store. A baggage drop is available at the start, with bags transported to the finish. The 10 km starts at Galeria Copernicus; the 5 km and Nordic Walking start from Józef Piłsudski Bridge (Camping Tramp). The finish is at the Municipal Stadium. Time limits are 1 hour 20 minutes for the 10 km, 50 minutes for the 5 km, and 60 minutes for Nordic Walking. PZLA-certified courses; fast, flat routes; 22:00 start; various distances; children’s race; medals and prizes; opportunity to take a guided walk.

name: Sudecki Festiwal Biegów Gorskich
description: The Sudecki Mountain Running Festival is a continuation of the Runs Along the Riese Trail in a new format, held in the scenic area around Głuszyca. The festival offers three distances: Sudecki Olbrzym (43 km), Półmaraton Szlakiem Riese (22 km), and Historyczna Dycha (10 km), with routes available in GPX format. The event attracts mountain running enthusiasts with challenging yet beautiful routes in the Sudetes. The organizer provides professional support and rankings in the international ITRA and UTMB Index systems.
course_highlights: Mountain routes of 10 km, 22 km, and 43 km
Scenic Sudetes landscapes and historic trails
Route profiles available in GPX format
additional: The race routes are available to download in GPX format. The event is ranked in the international ITRA and UTMB Index systems. The organizer is Stowarzyszenie Walim Na Żądanie, based in Głuszyca. mountain routes, online registration, access to GPX files

name: XII Festiwal Biegu Rzeźnika
description: The 12th Rzeźnik Running Festival will take place from June 3 to 6, 2026, in Cisna. This exceptional running event in the Bieszczady Mountains offers a wide choice of distances, from 5 km to an extreme 500 km, including ultraruns, marathons, and children’s races. The routes pass through the picturesque mountain terrain of the Beskids, offering unforgettable views and challenges for runners of varying experience levels. The festival also offers the opportunity to take part in hiking and cycling events and other accompanying activities.
course_highlights: Mountain routes in the Bieszczady Mountains, ranging from 5 km to 500 km
Scenic views and challenging climbs on the ultra and marathon routes
Special races for children and Nordic walking events
additional: The festival features numerous races at various distances, including Rzeźnicka Piątka (5 km), Dycha Na Jeleni Skok (12 km), Rzeźnicki Marsz z Walking Lovers (16 km), Rzeźniczek (28 km), Maraton Rzeźnika (52 km), Rzeźnik Ultra (95 km), Bieg Rzeźnika + Hardcore (80 km and 106 km), Rzeźnicki Szlem (175 km), and the stage-based Rzeźnik 500 hiking event. Children’s races cover distances from 100 to 2,000 m. The festival also includes hiking and cycling events and accompanying activities. Registration via voucher, children’s race participation, the detailed schedule, and results are available on the website.

name: Nocny Maraton Kanału Bydgoskiego od 2007r.
description: The Bydgoszcz Canal Night Marathon is Poland’s oldest continuously held night marathon, taking place since 2007. The race is run in the unique nighttime setting of the Bydgoszcz Planty and along the Bydgoszcz Canal’s distinctive historic hydraulic structures: its 18th-century locks. The canal is the oldest inland waterway in Poland. The event attracts runners from across Poland and abroad, offering generous race packs, original medals and T-shirts, and professional timekeeping. It is growing in prestige and is known for its lively atmosphere, live music, and numerous accompanying attractions.
course_highlights: A night race in the setting of the Bydgoszcz Planty
A route along the historic 18th-century locks of the Bydgoszcz Canal
A unique atmosphere with live music and artistic experiences
additional: There are 6 distances. Participants receive original medals, commemorative T-shirts, and generous race packs. Professional electronic timekeeping and race numbers are provided. Live music adds to the event’s appeal for runners and spectators. The event features 6 distances, electronic timekeeping, commemorative medals and T-shirts, and generous race packs. Participants can expect professional course markings and artistic entertainment during the race.

name: Bieg pod Tysiącletnimi Dębami

description: The Run Under the Millennial Oaks is a unique sporting event held in picturesque Kazimierz Biskupi, in the heart of Bieniszew Forest. The race brings together sport, history, and the beauty of the local landscape, taking participants along an avenue of millennial oaks in the Pustelnik Nature Reserve. The event is open to experienced runners, beginners, and families alike, with races over various distances and a Nordic walking event. It is organized by the Aktywny Kazimierz Biskupi Association and the Municipality of Kazimierz Biskupi, and the race tradition dates back to the beginning of the 21st century.

Running courses of 10 km and 5 km are available, along with a 5 km Nordic walking event

The winners’ awards ceremony and event closing take place after the race at 14:45. Participant limits: 250 for the main race, 150 for the accompanying race, and 100 for Nordic walking. The event was revived for the first time in 2007, with online registration available. Participants can look forward to attractive prizes and certificates.

The route runs through scenic surroundings, combining natural landscapes with an urban setting. It is a great opportunity to spend time actively and bring the running community together.

Scenic natural areas and urban surroundings
Organised by the experienced WKB PIAST running club

The event attracts both experienced triathletes and amateurs, offering the chance to qualify for the IRONMAN 70.3 World Championship. The atmosphere is filled with sporting excitement and the historic spirit of Warsaw, and the finish line is at the Multimedia Fountain Park, adding a distinctive character to the competition.

Athlete services include bike rental, bike transfer, bike build and pack, finisher photos, medal engraving, a camper park, licenses, and accommodation. The test is open to everyone, regardless of age, gender or running experience. Participants receive a race bib, a certificate with their result and a bottle of water. name: VI EKO Bieg z Gwizdkiem po Zdrowie

It takes place from 5–7 June 2026, with its base at the sports field on Leśna Street in Wdzydze Kiszewskie. The festival brings together the running community of Northern Poland, promotes a healthy lifestyle, and showcases local culture and nature. The programme includes races over various distances, Nordic walking events, and cycling rallies.
course_highlights: Running routes of 1.6 km, 5 km, 10 km, 15 km, and 21 km
Scenic Kashubian landscapes and the forests of the Kościerzyna Forest District
Promotion of the “Kashubian Sea” and nearby natural attractions

The event features various forms of physical activity, including running, walking, and cycling, promoting a healthy lifestyle in the Kashubian region.

name: XIII Maraton i Półmaraton Fundacji DASZR...
description: The 13th DASZRADE Foundation Marathon and Half Marathon, named after Barbara Karaczyńska, is a small-scale running event held in Opalenie and organized by the Daszrade Foundation in cooperation with the “Zapowiednik” Addiction Treatment Centre. The marathon course is entirely paved and runs through the scenic fields and forests of Kociewie. It is certified by the Polish Athletics Association and features numerous fairly steep climbs, with a total elevation gain of 646 m. The race takes place on a June morning and offers unforgettable views and a unique atmosphere. After the race, participants can enjoy a recovery meal, and everyone who finishes receives a commemorative medal, diploma and T-shirt.
course_highlights: Paved route through the fields and forests of Kociewie
646 m of total elevation gain, with numerous steep climbs
Course marked every 1 km, with aid stations every 5 km and on-course refreshment points

The 10 km “Olka” route partially overlaps with the half-marathon, is on a firm surface and runs through the forest. Paved route, 646 m of elevation gain, aid stations every 5 km, commemorative medals and T-shirts, 10 km “OLKA” route.

The event also features races for children and young people, making it appealing to families and participants of different age groups. Familiar and popular course without PZLA certification

The event takes place in the picturesque area of Czymanowo, right by Lake Żarnowieckie and the Kaszubskie Oko observation tower, creating a unique trail-running atmosphere. The organizer, the Pomerania Sports Association, together with local sports centers, invites both first-time participants and experienced ultrarunners to take part in this unforgettable event. It’s a great opportunity to take on challenging courses and enjoy the beauty of Kashubian nature.

Courses of 45 km, 25 km, and 10 km

The event promotes an active lifestyle and attracts runners from the region, offering a scenic route through the Tuchola Forests. The race takes place in Osieczna and is part of the Grand Prix Borów Tucholskich. Participants can expect professional organization and a welcoming atmosphere.

Scenic terrain in the Tuchola Forests

additional: The event is part of the Grand Prix Borów Tucholskich series, with the chance to win a unique collection as part of the series. Participants can expect competitive racing and attractive prizes.

The course runs through the town’s streets, giving participants the opportunity to compete at a professional level with officially recognized results. The event is open to everyone, including children and families, who can take part in accompanying races over shorter distances. The main race starts in the evening, giving the event its distinctive nighttime atmosphere. The organizers look after participants’ comfort by providing refreshments after the race and awards ceremonies for the winners.
course_highlights: Course certified by the Polish Athletics Association
Night race starting at 21:55
Urban course through the streets of Szamotuły

The event includes road closures and detours, and offers various distances, including 5 km, 255 m, and 555 m. Participants can find news and information on the website and Facebook.

description: The 8th edition of the Chwalisz Run is an annual charity race taking place on June 13, 2026, in Ściernie. The start and finish are located at Preschool No. 1 – Ściernie branch. The 5 km course runs mainly along forest paths, with very little asphalt, offering both challenges and the joy of running for experienced runners and beginners alike. All entry fees will go towards supporting Antoś Synowiec, a child with a rare genetic disease, highlighting the charitable nature of the event. The organizers also invite participants to join group training sessions every Thursday at 19:00.

The organizers provide professional medals, T-shirts featuring the Iskra aircraft, and prizes including trophies and vouchers for tandem flights. After the race, participants can admire the aircraft and enjoy refreshments and dietary supplements.

Start, finish, and awards ceremony in the hangars of the White-and-Red Wings Foundation

location: Leśnictwo Szulmierz, gmina Regimin, Mazowieckie, Poland
description: Leśna ZaDyszka is a race held in the picturesque Szulmierz Forest District in the Regimin municipality, promoting physical activity and a healthy lifestyle in forest areas. The course is a 5 km loop along forest tracks and a section of asphalt, showcasing the beauty of the Mazovian countryside. Participants can choose from three events: 5 km, 10 km (two loops), and 5 km Nordic Walking. Children can take part in a 1.5 km run with no classification. The start and finish are on a forest clearing by the Szulmierz-Regimin road, and times are recorded using a professional chip timing system.

Views of the Mazovian countryside and a fallow deer farm
The course is safeguarded by volunteers
additional: The race office is open from 9:00 on the forest clearing by the Szulmierz-Regimin road. Participants receive a commemorative medal and a restorative meal after the race. They can choose a standard T-shirt at no extra cost or a Premium LAS T-shirt for an additional 20 zł. Times are recorded using chips attached to participants’ shoes. Prizes are awarded for age-group and overall placements, with a prize draw among participants. Courses include forest tracks and asphalt, with various distances and categories, including running, Nordic Walking, and Cross Duathlon. Entry fees depend on the registration date.

The 5 km course runs through the town streets, offering official results and a unique night-race atmosphere. The event is open to everyone, including children and families, who can take part in accompanying races. It attracts considerable interest, and participants can look forward to refreshments and an awards ceremony after the race.

A night race starting at 21:55

name: VIII Kwidzyńska zaDyszka
description: The 8th Kwidzyńska zaDyszka is a 10 km road race taking place on June 13, 2026, in Kwidzyn. It’s a great opportunity to test your fitness on a scenic course and prepare for race day with training plans tailored to different experience levels. The event is aimed at runners with varying levels of experience who want to stay active and compete on a course of moderate difficulty. The organizers provide expert support and access to a platform for managing race information.
course_highlights: 10 km road course
Scenic surroundings in Kwidzyn
Course of moderate difficulty
additional: Training plans of 8 to 20 weeks are available, tailored to the runner’s VDOT level. Expert support and a platform for managing the race profile and marketing collaboration are provided. Registration runs from April 17 to June 8, 2025; participant limit: 200.

location: Zagwiździe, Gmina Murów, Opole Voivodeship, Poland
